recipe_version.title: Deep-Fried Cod with Oven-Roasted Potatoes
recipe_version.description: Cod in a club-soda batter, deep-fried until golden, with oven-roasted potato wedges whose edges are crisp. Lemon, parsley, and vinegar at the table. No butter.

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1 tsp potatoes, 1/2 tsp batter, 1 tsp fish

ingredients.name: club soda
ingredients.note: cold. The batter liquid is club soda, not beer and not milk.

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: canola or peanut-free vegetable oil, enough for about 2 inches in the pot

ingredients.name: white wine vinegar
ingredients.note: at the table, in place of malt vinegar

steps.title: Heat the oven and cut the potatoes
steps.body: Turn the oven to 425 F before anything else; it heats during this prep. Cut the potatoes into 3/4-inch wedges, toss with the olive oil, 1 tsp salt, and the pepper, and spread them on a sheet pan.

steps.title: Mix the batter and salt the cod
steps.body: Whisk the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and 1/2 tsp salt. Whisk in the egg and the cold club soda until just combined; a few lumps are fine. Pat the cod dry and salt it with the remaining 1 tsp. About 20 minutes for both prep steps, including the oven heat.

steps.title: Roast the potatoes
steps.body: Roast the potatoes at 425 F for 35 minutes, turning once halfway, until the centers are tender and the edges are crisp. Leave them in the oven if they finish a few minutes early.

steps.title: Deep-fry the cod
steps.body: When the potatoes have about 10 minutes left, heat the neutral oil to 375 F. Dip two fillets in batter, let the excess drip off, and deep-fry until deep golden and 145 F in the center, about 3 to 4 minutes. Drain on a rack. Repeat with the other two fillets. This sits inside the 35-minute roast.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Put the cod and potatoes on plates. Scatter the parsley and serve with lemon and the vinegar.

equipment: deep-fry thermometer or an instant-read thermometer that clips to the pot
